description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2225/17 of 28.04.2021 D/S Division, Akkavipattu
categorisation: This gazette notice is primarily concerned with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically amends dates related to a land acquisition notice (changing the date from June 28, 2021, to September 13, 2021, for a proceeding and extending a deadline from June 21, 2021, to August 23, 2021). The content deals with the administrative process of land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
